subject: Hosted→Dedicated migration rehearsal: sizing rehearsal & rollback gates

Subject: Hosted → Dedicated migration rehearsal request and requirements

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the call earlier. We want to run a formal rehearsal ahead of our migration from your hosted API to a Dedicated pool. Goal: surface any performance regressions, verify autoscaling behavior, and validate rollback/rollback-time targets before we cut primary traffic.

Quick asks from our side:
- A short preflight checklist with the exact metrics you’ll monitor during the rehearsal (latency p95, tail QPS, GPU utilization, token cost delta).
- A proposed rehearsal window in the first two weeks of November.
- Confirmation of rollback criteria and how long a rollback takes end-to-end.

I’ve attached our historical 90-day traffic profile (dealbedrock_traffic_profile.csv) and a brief note on peak spike patterns.

Would appreciate a draft plan by EOD Wednesday so we can align the ops team here.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Engineering
DealBedrock

On 2026-10-28 09:22, Alicia Ramos wrote:
> Thanks for the call earlier. We want to run a formal rehearsal ahead of our migration from your hosted API to a Dedicated pool...

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the traffic profile. Draft plan below (high level):

1) Rehearsal window proposal: Nov 10, 09:00–13:00 PT (we'll reserve a dedicated GPU pool and mirror 25–50% of your production traffic).
2) Metrics we'll monitor (we will send a one-page preflight checklist PDF):
   - 95th/99th latency (token-level + request-level),
   - GPU mem & util by worker,
   - request queuing and backpressure events,
   - token cost delta vs hosted baseline.
3) Sizing approach: initial dedicated pool = inferred from your 90-day 95th QPS plus 1.5x safety; can scale with burst capacity.
4) Rollback criteria: sustained p95 > 2x baseline for 10 minutes OR error rate > 1.5% for 5 continuous minutes triggers immediate rollback; expected rollback window = 18–30 minutes (dependent on checkpointing and cached KV warmup).

I attached our Redwood preflight checklist (redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf). Can you confirm the rehearsal date and whether Nov 20–21 works for your full migration weekend?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales (Dedicated)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-29T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Sizing estimate & fallback options for DealBedrock (DB-8753)

Team —

I ran a sizing pass against the traffic profile and our quota models. Key items (summary):
- Baseline 95th QPS (from CSV): 1,200 req/s; average tokens/request: 420.
- Recommended starting pool: 4x A100 equivalent workers (8 x GPU-slices) with continuous batching; translates to ~3.2M tok/min sustained.
- Burst headroom: enable 2x burst capacity via autoscale policy during rehearsals to cover sudden spikes.
- Cost/quality tradeoff: recommend int8 quantization profile for non-latency-critical routes; keep FP16 for chat endpoints.

Fallback options:
A) Progressive rollback (preferred): shift 30% of traffic back to hosted tier, monitor drift for 15 minutes, if still degraded shift 100%.
B) Immediate full rollback: when rollback criteria met or security incident.

Open questions for Ben/Karthik:
- Do we plan a warm cache preload for the rehearsal to speed KV availability? I suggest a 20-minute warmed soak prior to window.
- Who is primary on-call for the rehearsal (Redwood infra eng)?

I attached sizing_estimate_v2.xlsx with the spreadsheet.

- Marissa
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sizing_estimate_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 210KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@dealbedrock.com>, DealBedrock Ops <ops@dealbedrock.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed rehearsal timeline + go/no-go gates (DealBedrock)

Hi Alicia —

Following Ben's note and our sizing pass, proposed rehearsal & cutover cadence:

Rehearsal (internal + mirrored traffic): Nov 10, 09:00–13:00 PT
- 08:30 — warm cache preload (20 minutes), validate KV hit rates.
- 09:00 — begin 25% mirrored traffic; baseline telemetry collection (first 30m).
- 10:00 — increment to 50% mirrored, stress specific endpoints (batch + long-seq).
- 12:30 — initiate progressive rollback test (30% then 100%).
- 13:00 — post-rehearsal readout and retention of logs.

Go/No-go gates for full migration weekend (Nov 20–21):
Gate 1 (Preflight): All telemetry healthy during rehearsal; no sustained p95 spikes >1.5x baseline.
Gate 2 (Security/Compliance): SOC2 evidence (we will share attestation link) and network ACLs validated.
Gate 3 (Operational): On-call roster confirmed, rollback playbook signed off.

We will also prepare a short runbook for ops with explicit rollback commands and a 'kill-switch' to redirect traffic to the hosted tier.

Can you confirm SOC2 artifact recipients and whether your procurement team needs a formal SLA credit cap written into the migration SOW?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

SOC2: yes, please send the artifact link; our security reviewer (cc'd ops) will validate.

A couple of asks before rehearsal:

- Confirm expected rollback time (goal: <30 min end-to-end).
